tools.name: list_dailies
tools.description: List the thirteen daily puzzles, their descriptions, and exact daily identities. No puzzle answers. Use open_daily to play one or open the hub.

tools.name: open_daily
tools.description: Open the playable daily puzzle with normal controls, undo and finite hints, or the thirteen-puzzle hub. Progress lasts in the active widget and does not sync to the website. Do not describe or reveal solutions.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Explain the rules and normal controls for one Coronet Arcade game without revealing a puzzle answer.
